$comment: What walk.mjs visits and what it expects on each surface. Later waves EXTEND this file rather than the script.
Text matching is case-insensitive with whitespace collapsed, over the page's rendered text (innerText) plus its title.

Placeholders: $villageName, $restorativeStep, $careRoleName, $careHolderName come from the seed's facts; $viewerName is the signed-in person; $brandTerms expands to the BANNED list in scripts/check-brand-refs.mjs and matches whole words only.
A surface with required: false that does not exist yet is reported as missing and does not fail the walk. A required one that is missing fails it.

expect.<role>.path: the pathname the page must end on after it settles (for a redirect). views: a button to press, by its accessible name, from the resting page; roles limits who is shown that button.

roles.member: a member with no seat and no admin reach
roles.founder: founder 1, who holds the canvas pen before the handover
